winning_patterns: Real temple or place with a physical mystery (Tungnath, Lepakshi) in the title
Festival-timed darshan (Navratri) uploaded before/during the festival
Famous story told with the deity's name hidden in the hook ('Ek BACHCHA ne SURAJ nigal liya')
avoid: Very well-known stories with the name revealed up front (Eklavya, Samudra Manthan, Narasimha)
